question: What is the name of the writer of Tomb of Sand, the first Hindi book to be awarded the International Booker Prize
solution:
The correct answer is __**Geetanjali Shree**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Geetanjali Shree** is the author of the Hindi novel *Tomb of Sand*, which became the first Hindi-language book to win the **International Booker Prize** in 2022.
 
• The book *Tomb of Sand*, originally titled *Ret Samadhi* in Hindi, was translated into English by **Daisy Rockwell**.
 
• The story explores themes such as **loss, grief, and identity**, centering on an 80-year-old woman who embarks on a journey to Pakistan following the death of her husband.
 
• *Tomb of Sand* is recognized for its innovative narrative style and deep cultural insights, marking a milestone for Hindi literature on the global stage.
 
• The International Booker Prize is awarded annually for a book translated into English, emphasizing the importance of translated literature worldwide.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **International Booker Prize**:

 
 
• Formerly known as the Man Booker International Prize, this prestigious literary award recognizes works translated into English and published in the UK or Ireland.
 
• The prize money of £50,000 is equally split between the author and the translator, highlighting the critical role of translation in global literature.
 
 
 
• **Geetanjali Shree**:
 
 
• A celebrated Hindi author, Geetanjali Shree has written several novels and short stories, including *Mai*, *Hamara Shahar Us Baras*, and *Tirohit*.
 
• Her works are known for their exploration of gender, identity, and societal issues, often blending realism with imaginative storytelling.
 
 
 
• **Daisy Rockwell**:
 
 
• An accomplished translator, painter, and writer, Daisy Rockwell translated *Ret Samadhi* into *Tomb of Sand*, garnering global recognition for her efforts.
 
• She has translated several other works of Hindi and Urdu literature into English, contributing significantly to the accessibility of South Asian literature worldwide.
 
 
 
• **Significance of Translated Literature**:
 
 
• Translated literature bridges cultural and linguistic gaps, offering readers an opportunity to engage with diverse perspectives and stories.
 
• It plays a crucial role in promoting global literary heritage and fostering cross-cultural understanding.
